task_requirement_decision.selected_installation: Windows Server 2025 May 2026 Standard with Desktop Experience
task_requirement_decision.basis: Microsoft lists UEFI/TPM as requirements for certain features, with additional TPM/Secure Boot/VBS requirements for Secured-core. This task selects neither Secured-core nor BitLocker. Desktop Experience recommends 4 GB RAM; 32 GB storage is an absolute minimum. No required feature is disabled and Windows 11 requirements are not inferred for Server.
